$comment: Amigo secreto in groups (bipe-chat/bipe#1527). No server logic. The organiser's phone draws, then sends each participant one to-device message (resultEventType) with the person they drew and the wish keys, and deletes the pairs. The setup is an encrypted timeline event in the group (setupEventType); every change sends a new one with the same setupId, the newest wins. invited are people not on Bipe yet, a display name only; a person who joins through the group link claims one invited slot. The draw needs every invited slot claimed, or the organiser drops the unclaimed ones with drawWithJoined. Exclusions are pairs that may not draw each other, in both directions. Rules: checkAmigoSecretoSetup, drawAmigoSecreto, checkAmigoSecretoPairs in tools/lib/amigo-secreto.mjs; test-vectors/amigo-secreto.json. Wishes: each participant's phone encrypts its wish list with its own wishKey (wishCipher) and posts it in the group as wishEventType with its wishTag. Only the person who drew them got the same key and tag, so only that person can read it. The anonymous hint step (dica) is not in this version: it waits for MZ (ADR 0247).
